Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 131. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Weapon Technique
Ki Cost: 6 ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Ranged
Weapon that you are proficient with.
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Weapon’s Range
Duration: Instantaneous
Chargeable: Yes
You focus your shot with a small portion of your ki,
firing it once they are within range with much more
force. Make a Ranged Combo Attack Roll, on a hit, they
take your weapon’s damage + 1d4. Creatures who are
hit with this attack, they are knocked back 15 feet.
